analysis: Examined the status display and keep-serving unenroll changes. StatusCommand.swift head 135-140 now uses state.displayedProviderAuthorization (new, implementation not supplied) to choose whether to show the App Attest summary, and passes a separate removalAuthorization from currentProviderAuthorization into ProviderAuthorizationReadiness.summary. This is display-only: the operator-visible text may report App Attest authorization while a lease is unexpired but a renewal is late (test StatusCommandRunTests head 279-305 expects "MDM removal needs fresh coordinator readiness" and no unenroll prompt). The security-relevant MDM-removal gate in UnenrollCommand+KeepServing.swift is unchanged: head 21-27 and 61-67 still gate on currentProviderAuthorization + removalReady, re-checked after the profile inventory; only the error message call (head 24-25) gained removalAuthorization: authorization. No serving/routing authority derives from the local status file; coordinator authorization (TB-011, T-053, T-057, A-016) remains authoritative. Residual integration questions: verify displayedProviderAuthorization (DaemonState, ProviderCore) does not feed any gating path (doctor, unenroll, watchdog, routing) and that summary(..., removalAuthorization:) never advertises removal availability when removalAuthorization is nil/stale, since misleading removal guidance could induce premature MDM removal (T-057). Those implementations are outside the supplied evidence; tests assert the intended behavior. No regression identified.
